summary: Graviton support is implemented for PyTorch 1.12.1 and TensorFlow 2.9.1; nothing committed. Changes: pytorch.json and tensorflow.json gained inference versions with processors ["graviton"], container_version "ubuntu20.04-sagemaker", and the 1.12.0/2.8.0 registry maps; tensorflow.json also gained the "2.9" alias. src/sagemaker/image_uris.py: Graviton families (matched by _is_graviton_family, e.g. c6g, t4g, m6gd, x2gd) map to the graviton processor only when the version offers it; the repo gets a "-graviton" suffix and the tag uses "cpu"; version-level processors now take precedence over top-level ones. Added three tests to tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_retrieve.py. Verified: both spec URIs match exactly, and test_retrieve.py passes (27 tests incl. new ones, run with a /tmp mock shim since the shared venv lacks the mock package). Not verified: test_dlc_frameworks.py and test_pytorch.py did not complete a run. Open decisions: the spec's example calls omit version and image_scope, which the code requires; 1.12.1 offers only graviton, so ml.c5 on that version is rejected; the regex also matches g5g.
